mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, reducing real interest rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for three consecutive months, or the signal fails to outperform a random baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in private demand, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, thereby boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which increases the probability of a Fed policy response, lowering real rates and lifting equity prices, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during INDPRO contraction periods, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year growth of real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 3.0% signals strong underlying demand, which may lead to inflationary pressures and a Fed tightening cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 3.0%, or the signal fails to produce a negative Rank IC in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising CPIAUCSL and a persistently low FEDFUNDS rate signals that inflation is accelerating while monetary policy remains accommodative, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.8% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 142,000 indicate a deteriorating labor market, which increases the likelihood of a Fed rate cut, reducing real rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative or insignificant coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters, combined with weak residential construction (HOUST), indicates a deepening economic slowdown, which increases the probability of aggressive fiscal or monetary stimulus, lifting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are below thresholds, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
